notes: No amp+cab block — running into tube amp. Single patch with CTL pedal toggling between clean verse and heavy chorus. Confirmed rig: Thom Yorke used a Fender Telecaster Plus through a Fender Twin Reverb (clean channel) for verse. Jonny Greenwood's famous pre-chorus scrape is a pick rake on strings — no additional effect needed, pure technique. GUV DS (Guv'nor) approximates the Marshall Guv'nor distortion used for chorus. Four Pedal Assign parameters change simultaneously via CTL pedal toggle.

signal_chain.notes: Used at high drive to approximate the Marshall Guv'nor character for the chorus. BYPASSED in Snapshot 1 (clean verse). ACTIVE in Snapshot 2 (heavy chorus).
Clean verse uses gentle EQ — just mild body and presence boost. Heavy chorus tightens low cut and boosts mids more aggressively. Level raised in chorus snapshot to match expected volume increase.

Tempo-synced to 92 BPM. Eighth note = 326ms — original target was 360ms (34ms off), using synced eighth note instead. Low mix in both snapshots — delay is supportive depth, not a feature. Slightly lower mix in heavy chorus so delay doesn't clutter the distortion.
Clean verse uses moderate hall reverb. Heavy chorus swells reverb for extra drama — this was a Pedal Assign target in the original design.

ctl_pedal_assign.function: Toggle between clean verse and heavy chorus
ctl_pedal_assign.note: CTL pedal toggles OD/DS on/off AND simultaneously adjusts Preamp Gain, Reverb level, and Chorus level via Pedal Assign. On Helix LT this is achieved through snapshot switching — assign FS1 and FS2 to Snapshots 1 and 2.

1_clean_verse.description: Clean verse tone. Stupor OD bypassed. Gentle EQ. Moderate reverb at 38% mix. Short eighth note delay at 22% mix. Gate open at -68dB.

2_heavy_chorus.description: Heavy chorus tone. Stupor OD active at Drive 7.5. Tighter EQ with mid boost +4dB. Reverb swells to 55% mix for drama. Delay pulls back to 15% mix. Gate tightens to -52dB.

playing_notes.pickup_notes: Neck for clean verse (Snapshot 1). Bridge for heavy chorus (Snapshot 2).
playing_notes.technique: Jonny's famous pre-chorus scrape is a pick rake across the strings — no additional effect needed, this is pure technique. The string scrape occurs just before you stomp to Snapshot 2.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Switch to Snapshot 2 exactly as the chorus hits. The string scrape happens in Snapshot 1 (clean) — the heavy distortion kicks in on the first chord of the chorus proper.
playing_notes.capo_note: Song is in G major. Can be played with open position G chord shapes, no capo needed.
